project_type: Full-stack app: React 18 + Vite frontend with Supabase backend (PostgreSQL). Monorepo with SQL migrations, frontend app, and test suites.
build_system: npm + Vite (frontend), plain SQL migrations (backend). Makefile at repo root wraps common commands.
test_framework: vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library/react, test-setup.ts for globals. SQL tests in tests/ directory (pgTAP-style). Playwright for E2E under frontend/e2e/.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `cd frontend && npx vitest run` for unit tests. 2. Run `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit` for type-checking. 3. Ensure no regressions in existing 1256 tests.
environment_constraints: GitHub access via gh CLI (REST only). No live Supabase connection for integration testing. SQL migrations are validated structurally (syntax, naming conventions). Frontend tests mock supabase client. E2E tests require .env.e2e (missing - tests excluded from vitest config as part of this work).
contribution_requirements: Each phase is a separate PR. Migrations are idempotent and re-runnable. No service_role in browser. All writes via SECURITY DEFINER RPCs. Existing tests must stay green. Migration naming: v1.1.8, v1.1.9, v1.2.0, v1.2.1, v1.2.2.
key_patterns: Stores use zustand 5 create() pattern. Supabase queries use fromTable() helper from @/lib/supabase. RPCs called via supabase.rpc(). Types defined in @/types/database.ts matching DB schema. Engines in @/engines/ are pure functions. BOM pipeline (bomPipeline.ts) takes BomPipelineInput with snapshotData/measurements/configuration/ruleSet/permissions/compatibilityRules. Path aliases: @/ = frontend/src/. Tests in __tests__/ directories next to source.
directory_structure: Root: baseline/ (DDL), migrations/ (patches), tests/ (SQL regression), frontend/ (React app), docs/, ci/. Frontend: src/stores/ (zustand), src/engines/ (BOM calculation), src/types/ (TS interfaces), src/lib/ (utilities), src/components/ (React components), e2e/ (Playwright).
